recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and draw a thin dark-red (#CC0000) rectangular border framing the entire content area (title band plus both plot panels).
2. Add one centered title text box in the top band (~5-20% of slide height, full width): 'Nearest Neighbors' in bold red (#CC0000) followed by '(NN) Equal Distance' in bold blue (#0000CC), large sans-serif.
3. At the top-right corner of the frame, draw a small yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle badge with the black (#000000) number '47' centered inside.
4. Left panel (approx. 10-48% of slide width, 25-85% of height): draw an L-shaped axis in red (#CC0000) - a vertical line with an upward arrowhead on the left edge and a horizontal line with a rightward arrowhead along the bottom; no tick marks or axis labels.
5. In the left panel, place three clusters of filled circular dots with thin dark outlines (counts approximate per source): 10 green (#7CFC00) dots in a diagonal cluster in the upper-left, 9 cyan (#00E5E5) dots in a cluster in the upper-right, 6 tan/beige (#F5D7A8) dots in a cluster at bottom-center.
6. Below the left panel, add the caption 'Data of Three Classes' in bold red (#CC0000), smaller than the title.
7. Right panel (approx. 52-90% of slide width, 25-85% of height): replicate the step-4 axes and the step-5 three dot clusters at the same relative positions.
8. In the right panel, add one large red (#CC0000) filled circle (the query point) near the center of the plot.
9. From the query point, draw a thin light-red/pink (#F4A0A0) straight connector line to every data dot (all 10 green, 9 cyan and 6 tan dots), each line ending in a small red (#CC0000) arrowhead at the dot.
10. Highlight two dots positioned at equal distance from the query point: choose one dot from the green cluster to the left of the query point and one dot from the tan cluster below-right of it, fill both with yellow (#FFFF66), and draw a dashed red (#CC0000) circle around each; the equal distance conveys the slide's message (title 'Equal Distance', caption 'No Unique Nearest Neighbor').
11. Below the right panel, add the caption 'No Unique Nearest Neighbor' in bold red (#CC0000), same size as the left caption.
12. Final check: white background, thin red frame, no tick labels, no photographs, no other text or elements; both panels appear fully built with all connector lines and highlights visible (static frame).
